evidence_policy: Use official Blizzard material for the 4.4.2 release, the later Presence modifier, and later hotfix scope; use current Cataclysm Classic guides and spell pages for observations; use repository and historical SQL only for identities or executable-state findings. Preserve conflicts, post-cutoff evidence, and absent implementation as fidelity_blocked. Never schedule an unresolved value.

10N.stable_difficulty_delta: Normal has the plate/roll loop without the Heroic Degradation and Blood Corruption package.
10N.cutoff_modifier_state: Dragon Soul unlocks at the requested cutoff; Presence of the Dragon Soul was not active at that instant.

10H.stable_difficulty_delta: Heroic adds Degradation and Blood Corruption; each plate is generally attacked through two tendon exposures.
10H.cutoff_modifier_state: Dragon Soul unlocks at the requested cutoff; Presence of the Dragon Soul was not active at that instant.

25N.stable_difficulty_delta: Normal mechanics repeat at 25-player scale; exact health, damage, and spawn coefficients are not frozen.
25N.cutoff_modifier_state: Dragon Soul unlocks at the requested cutoff; Presence of the Dragon Soul was not active at that instant.

25H.stable_difficulty_delta: Heroic adds the debuff package and commonly requires additional Blood/Amalgamation control or a third tank; exact 25H scaling is blocked.
25H.cutoff_modifier_state: Dragon Soul unlocks at the requested cutoff; Presence of the Dragon Soul was not active at that instant.

at_requested_cutoff.reason: The official notes place Dragon Soul opening at 3:00 p.m. PST on February 20, 2025; no Presence stage had begun at the unlock boundary.

later_hotfix_scope.february_21_2025: Yor'sahj-specific fixes; no Spine tuning identified
later_hotfix_scope.april_3_2025: Spine Essence of Corrupted Deathwing loot addition and Dragon Soul LFG enablement; later loot/access delta, not cutoff encounter tuning

tanks: Control Corruptions, Amalgamations, and the growing Blood population without allowing an unintended residue feed.
In Heroic 25, use a third-tank or kite arrangement only after build-verified add scaling and threat rules.
Position the superheated Amalgamation for Nuclear Blast near the intended plate while preserving raid movement for rolls.
healers: Cover Searing Plasma absorbs, Fiery Grip periodic damage, Grasping Tendrils, Superheated Nucleus, and Burst.
In Heroic, handle Blood Corruption dispel/mutation decisions only with verified target and failure semantics.
Keep the tendon exposure team alive through the short Seal Armor Breach window.
raid: Keep raid weight intentionally on one side for a controlled Deathwing roll and enter Grasping Tendrils before the roll.
Kill Corrupted Bloods in a controlled pattern, avoid premature residue consumption, and prevent avoidable Burst overlap.
Use the same-side tendon for both exposures on each plate and repeat for all three plates.
dps: Lower the casting Corruption to break Fiery Grip, but do not promote the conflicting 16% or 20% threshold as executable.
Feed exactly nine Residues to the selected Amalgamation, then burst the superheated target and each exposed tendon.
Keep Blood and respawned Corruption control aligned with the current plate stage.

gates.condition: Sky Captain Swayze starts the back-of-Deathwing sequence after Blackhorn
Four initial Corruptions and at least one remaining/respawning Corruption
Corruptions apply the absorb and grip package
Players enter tendrils to avoid being flung
Blood death produces Burst and Residue
Superheated Amalgamation death casts Nuclear Blast
Same-side tendon is exposed twice to detach one plate
Later Presence aura can be removed by Lord Devrestrasz

players in tendrils; Amalgamations are not protected
nearby raid on Blood death; practical room-wide effect reported

lifecycle.prerequisite: Guides place Spine after Warmaster Blackhorn; local prerequisite enforcement is absent/unresolved.
lifecycle.pull: Sky Captain Swayze 55870/parachute sequence is source-reported; local trigger and teleport lifecycle are absent.
lifecycle.phase_sequence: Four Corruptions -> controlled roll -> Blood/Residue -> nine-stack Amalgamation -> tendon exposure; repeat for three plates.
lifecycle.later_loot: April 3, 2025 Essence of Corrupted Deathwing drop is post-cutoff and not applied.
